The app creates local on-device server and directs all outgoing HTTPS traffic to it. When it is done app captures HTTPS requests, makes dummy leaf certificates for requested domains and acts as man-in-the-middle proxy to read and store data. Data is stored only in local device database and WebProxyTool developers do not have access to it. The app works without any remote servers involved.
